name: Import Agisoft Metashape Project
description: A process to import a Agisoft Metashape project

parameters.label: Agisoft Metashape XML project file
parameters.description: Input Agisoft Metashape XML project file

parameters.label: Project CRS
parameters.description: A valid CRS identifier (EPSG:25830+5782, EPSG:25830, ...) for replace the internal Project CRS in XML. Empty for no use

parameters.label: Cameras CRS
parameters.description: A valid CRS identifier ( EPSG:4326, EPSG:4258+5782, ...) for replace the internal Cameras CRS in XML. Empty for no use

parameters.label: Markers CRS
parameters.description: A valid CRS identifier (EPSG:25830+5782, EPSG:25830, ...) for replace the internal Markers CRS in XML. Empty for no use

parameters.label: Undistorted images path
parameters.description: Undistorted input images path, used recursively. Undistortion must conserve the calibrated focal distance and principal point. Empty for no use
